notes: Fleet Weekly Score Trend's Change column showed Active IQ's own percentageChange field, which is documented as 'percentage change vs. previous week' but doesn't reconcile with the adjacent scorePercentage values in the same list (e.g. 57.1% -> 56.9% showed '+1.5%' instead of the visible -0.2 point move). Replaced with a value computed directly from the two adjacent weekly scores, formatted in percentage points, so every Change cell is now self-evidently correct against the Score column next to it. Applied the same fix to the Week-over-Week Change stat card above the table.
